description: This file defines the ContentManagementServices class, which provides a set of static methods implementing content management functionalities for the Apache OFBiz framework. The methods include creating, updating, retrieving, and manipulating content, content associations, site roles, and content types, interacting with entities like Content, DataResource, ContentAssoc, and related services. The class serves as a central service layer for content operations within the OFBiz content application module.

classes.name: ContentManagementServices
classes.description: This class provides static methods for managing content entities, associations, roles, and content types within the OFBiz framework's content application module.

methods.name: getSubContent
methods.description: Finds and retrieves the related subContent given a template content and a mapKey, delegating the actual retrieval and cache management to ContentWorker.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Retrieves content view object from cache based on a contentId.

methods.name: persistContentAndAssoc
methods.description: Creates or updates a Content entity, associated ContentAssoc, DataResource, and ElectronicText based on provided context, handling permissions, relationships, and optional data uploads.

methods.name: updateSiteRoles
methods.description: Associates or de-associates a party with site roles by creating or removing ContentRole entries.

methods.name: persistDataResourceAndData
methods.description: Handles permissions and calls persistDataResourceAndDataMethod to create or update data resources and associated data, such as images or text.

methods.name: persistDataResourceAndDataMethod
methods.description: Performs the actual creation or update of DataResource and related records, including handling image data, electronic text, and file uploads.

methods.name: addRoleToUser
methods.description: Creates content roles for all UserLogin entries associated with a specified party.

methods.name: updateSiteRolesDyn
methods.description: Dynamically updates or removes site roles for a given contentId and partyId, creating or deactivating roles as specified.

methods.name: updateOrRemove
methods.description: Creates or removes entity records based on action parameter and provided primary key fields.

methods.name: resequence
methods.description: Reorders sequence numbers in ContentAssoc entities of a given parent content, optionally switching sequence positions up or down.

methods.name: changeLeafToNode
methods.description: Converts a Content record to a node type, clones and associates a subcontent if applicable.

methods.name: updateLeafCount
methods.description: Updates the child leaf count statistic for content starting from a specified contentId.

methods.name: updatePageType
methods.description: Changes the contentTypeId of a content and its children to represent outline or page modes, updating hierarchical structure accordingly.

methods.name: resetToOutlineMode
methods.description: Resets a content and its subcontents to the OUTLINE_NODE type, adjusting hierarchy and types.

methods.name: clearContentAssocViewCache
methods.description: Clears cache related to ContentAssocView entities for freshness.

methods.name: clearContentAssocDataResourceViewCache
methods.description: Clears cache related to ContentAssocViewDataResource entities.

methods.name: updatePageNodeChildren
methods.description: Recursively updates contentTypeId of children to PAGE_NODE.

methods.name: updateOutlineNodeChildren
methods.description: Recursively updates contentTypeId of children to OUTLINE_NODE based on branch conditions.

methods.name: findSubNodes
methods.description: Queries for sub-content DataResource views related to a contentId.

methods.name: updateTypeAndFile
methods.description: Updates mimeTypeId and objectInfo (filename) for a DataResource record.

methods.name: initContentChildCounts
methods.description: Initializes or recalculates child leaf counts for a content record.
